'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Thomas Schumann DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Schumann]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Black Sun]]
* '''Username:''' RepCom 1136
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
